metadata.title: Mid-Century Rock and Roll Album Cover

recipe.visualDefinition: A vintage square composition featuring a central photographic scene of men on motorcycles, framed by a large, irregular, torn-paper-style blue shape that contains bold, stacked typography. The overall aesthetic is defined by high-contrast primary colors, a grainy film texture, and a distinct horizontal division between the text-heavy upper half and the image-heavy lower half.
coreVisualRelationships: The jagged, torn-edge blue silhouette acts as a container for both the title and the photographic subject.
A thin white horizontal rule separates the primary title from the secondary artist name and the image.
The red of the motorcycles provides a sharp chromatic contrast against the deep blue and earthy background tones.
coreInvariants: Irregular, hand-torn paper edge effect for the central blue field.
Stacked, centered, heavy-weight slab serif typography.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The photographic subjects are positioned in the lower third of the frame, scaled to fit within the bottom portion of the blue cutout.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bold, lime-green title text in the upper half serves as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright title, moves down across the white dividing line to the artist name, and finally rests on the red motorcycles.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The cream-colored outer border provides significant negative space, emphasizing the central 'torn' shape.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep navy blue serves as the primary background for the central graphic element.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cream/Off-white acts as the outer frame and background for the lower text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Lime green for the main title and vibrant red for the motorcycles.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the green and red accents against a dark, low-value blue field.

letterConstructionRules: Uniform stroke weight with heavy, blocky serifs.
Tall x-height and tight character spacing.
Vertical stress with flat horizontal terminals.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Condensed proportions to allow for tight stacking of multiple words.

composition.relationshipToImage: Contained within blue field above the photo

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family with varying weights and colors to distinguish hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serifs and geometric structure.
Provides the correct mid-century slab serif aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square image with a cream border. Inside, place a large navy blue shape with jagged, hand-torn edges. The bottom half of the blue shape should contain a grainy 1960s-style photo of men on vintage red motorcycles on a roadside with a rocky, brush-filled background. A thin white horizontal line should bisect the blue shape.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three lines of large, centered, lime-green all-caps slab serif text in the top half. Add three lines of smaller, centered, cream-colored all-caps slab serif text just below the white line, overlaying the top of the photo.

verificationChecks: Is the blue shape's edge sufficiently irregular and 'torn'?
Is the main title lime green and the secondary text cream?
Is the photography style appropriately grainy and vintage?

mustRedesign: Any brand logos on the motorcycles
postGenerationChecks: Check for 'halftone' or 'offset' printing artifacts in the photo area.
Ensure the text is perfectly centered horizontally.
Verify the cream border is consistent around all four sides.
Confirm the slab serifs are blocky and not rounded.
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a vintage outdoor photograph, mask it with a torn-paper shape on a solid dark field, bisect with a thin rule, and apply heavy slab serif typography in high-contrast colors.
